verdict.rationale: Glama's evidence shows a static registry/search UI and per-tool enable/disable configuration (glama-docs-5, glama-docs-6, glama-docs-11) plus gateway logging/access control (glama-docs-4, glama-docs-28), but nothing describes an agent-facing meta-tool that lets an AI dynamically search and load tool definitions at runtime to avoid context bloat. No documentation or probe evidence mentions such a runtime tool-discovery API for agents.
